what: New York City Demographic Data from the Census
title: New York City Demographic Data from the Census
text: nycdemog package provides county-, tract-, block-level demographic data five counties New York City, derived US Census Bureau via tidycensus. provides set tibbles keyed geoid covering race, age sex, household structure, income poverty, education, employment, housing, language nativity, alongside thin wrapper functions help make NYC-queries Census API. tract- block-level datasets join 1:1 corresponding sf objects nycmaps package, geoid column. county-level datasets join nycmaps::nyc_boros_sf county column, matches nycmaps::nyc_boros$short_county_name.

title: New York City Demographic Data from the Census
text: can install development version nycdemog GitHub : pre-built data tables package. wrapper functions pull Census API require Census API key, set CENSUS_API_KEY environment variable.

title: New York City Demographic Data from the Census
text: get_nyc_acs() get_nyc_decennial() thin wrappers around tidycensus::get_acs() tidycensus::get_decennial() hard-code five NYC counties, never download geometry, return tidy tibble keyed lowercase geoid. Use load_nyc_variables() browse variable catalogues:
code: library(nycdemog)  # Median household income, latest 5-year ACS, NYC tracts get_nyc_acs(c(med_hhinc = "B19013_001"))  # Race and Hispanic origin with total population as the denominator race_vars <- c(   nh_white = "B03002_003",   nh_black = "B03002_004",   nh_asian = "B03002_006",   hispanic = "B03002_012" ) get_nyc_acs(race_vars, summary_var = "B03002_001")  # 2020 PL block-level race counts get_nyc_decennial(   c(nh_white = "P2_005N", hispanic = "P2_002N"),   geography = "block",   sumfile = "pl",   summary_var = "P1_001N" )  # One row per borough get_nyc_acs(c(med_hhinc = "B19013_001"), geography = "county") load_nyc_variables(2024, "acs5") load_nyc_variables(2020, "pl") load_nyc_variables(2020, "dhc")

title: New York City Demographic Data from the Census
text: Every stored tract- block-level tibble joins geoid matching sf object nycmaps; county-level tibbles join nycmaps::nyc_boros_sf county. Mapping median household income across NYC tracts:  – Hex photo: Detail Terry Sydney, “New York City 1979”.
code: library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) library(sf) library(nycmaps)  nyc_census_tracts_2020_sf |>   inner_join(nyc_tract_acs_income_df, by = "geoid") |>   ggplot(aes(fill = med_hhinc)) +   geom_sf(color = NA) +   scale_fill_viridis_c(     option = "magma",     labels = scales::label_dollar(),     na.value = "grey90"   ) +   labs(fill = "Median\nhousehold\nincome") +   theme_void()

what: Get American Community Survey data for New York City — get_nyc_acs
title: Get American Community Survey data for New York City — get_nyc_acs
text: thin wrapper around tidycensus::get_acs() hard-codes New York City geographies, never downloads geometry, returns tidy tibble keyed geoid (lowercased) county column (borough name) ready joining spatial objects nycmaps package.

title: Get American Community Survey data for New York City — get_nyc_acs
code: get_nyc_acs(   variables,   year = NULL,   geography = c("tract", "block group", "county", "puma"),   survey = "acs5",   summary_var = NULL,   output = c("wide", "tidy"),   ... )

title: Get American Community Survey data for New York City — get_nyc_acs
text: variables character vector (optionally named) Census variable IDs. See load_nyc_variables() tidycensus::load_variables(). year ACS endyear. NULL (default), uses tidycensus::get_acs() default, recent vintage tidycensus supports. geography Geographic level. One "tract" (default), "block group", "county", "puma". "tract", "block group", "county" request restricted five NYC counties via tidycensus's county argument. "puma", tidycensus accept county filter, NY state PUMAs requested filtered 55 NYC PUMAs using internal crosswalk. crosswalk vintage chosen year: ACS endyears including 2021 use 2010 PUMA vintage, 2022 later use 2020 vintage. See nyc_pumas(). survey ACS sample, passed tidycensus::get_acs(). Defaults "acs5". summary_var Optional summary (denominator) variable. output "wide" (default) "tidy". "wide", variable column pivoted variable becomes column. ... Additional arguments forwarded tidycensus::get_acs().

title: Get American Community Survey data for New York City — get_nyc_acs
text: tibble geoid county first two columns, followed requested variables. ACS endyear actually used stored "acs_year" attribute.

title: Get American Community Survey data for New York City — get_nyc_acs
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Median household income, latest 5-year ACS, NYC tracts. get_nyc_acs(c(med_hhinc = "B19013_001"))  # Same, but at the PUMA level. get_nyc_acs(   c(med_hhinc = "B19013_001"),   geography = "puma" )  # Same, but one row per borough. get_nyc_acs(   c(med_hhinc = "B19013_001"),   geography = "county" )  # Race and Hispanic origin, with total population as the denominator. race_vars <- c(   nh_white = "B03002_003",   nh_black = "B03002_004",   nh_asian = "B03002_006",   hispanic = "B03002_012" ) get_nyc_acs(race_vars, summary_var = "B03002_001") } # }

what: Get Decennial Census data for New York City — get_nyc_decennial
title: Get Decennial Census data for New York City — get_nyc_decennial
text: thin wrapper around tidycensus::get_decennial() hard-codes five New York City counties, never downloads geometry, returns tidy tibble keyed geoid (lowercased) county column ready joining spatial objects nycmaps package.

title: Get Decennial Census data for New York City — get_nyc_decennial
code: get_nyc_decennial(   variables,   year = 2020,   geography = c("tract", "block", "block group", "county"),   sumfile = "pl",   summary_var = NULL,   output = c("wide", "tidy"),   ... )

title: Get Decennial Census data for New York City — get_nyc_decennial
text: variables character vector (optionally named) Census variable IDs. See load_nyc_variables() tidycensus::load_variables(). year Decennial Census year. Defaults 2020. 2000 2010 also accepted tidycensus. geography Geographic level. One "tract" (default), "block", "block group", "county". sumfile Census summary file. Defaults "pl" (redistricting file). tract-level demographic housing characteristics use "dhc". summary_var Optional summary (denominator) variable. output "wide" (default) "tidy". ... Additional arguments forwarded tidycensus::get_decennial().

title: Get Decennial Census data for New York City — get_nyc_decennial
text: tibble geoid county first two columns, followed requested variables. Census year sumfile used stored "decennial_year" "decennial_sumfile" attributes.

title: Get Decennial Census data for New York City — get_nyc_decennial
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # 2020 PL 94-171 race and Hispanic origin at the block level. race_vars <- c(   nh_white = "P2_005N",   nh_black = "P2_006N",   nh_asian = "P2_008N",   hispanic = "P2_002N" ) get_nyc_decennial(   race_vars,   geography = "block",   sumfile = "pl",   summary_var = "P1_001N" )  # 2020 DHC household type at tract level. get_nyc_decennial(   c(family_hh = "H9_002N", nonfamily_hh = "H9_009N"),   geography = "tract",   sumfile = "dhc" )  # 2020 PL 94-171 total population, one row per borough. get_nyc_decennial(   c(total_pop = "P1_001N"),   geography = "county",   sumfile = "pl" ) } # }

title: Look up Census variables — load_nyc_variables
text: Convenience wrapper around tidycensus::load_variables() browsing variable catalogues used get_nyc_acs() get_nyc_decennial(). result identical direct tidycensus call; function exists NYC-oriented Census helpers live one place.

title: Look up Census variables — load_nyc_variables
Look up Census variables — load_nyc_variables
text: year year, endyear, dataset. dataset Dataset name. Common choices: "acs5", "pl", "dhc", "sf1". See tidycensus::load_variables() full list. cache Whether cache variable table disk re-use across sessions. Defaults TRUE (opposite upstream default, caching almost always want package work).

title: Look up Census variables — load_nyc_variables
text: tibble variable IDs, labels, concepts.
